title.original: Diagonal-Tiled Mixed-Precision Attention for Efficient Low-Bit MXFP Inference
title.zh: 高效低位MXFP推理的对角平铺混合精度注意
title.en: Diagonal-Tiled Mixed-Precision Attention for Efficient Low-Bit MXFP Inference

inclusion_reason.zh: DMA 是可复用的 Triton 低比特注意力 kernel，将 MXFP tile 调度、精度选择和融合归约落实到执行运行时。
inclusion_reason.en: DMA is a reusable low-bit Triton attention kernel that implements MXFP tile scheduling, precision selection, and fused reduction in the execution runtime.

abstract.zh: DMA 是面向 MXFP 低比特格式的混合精度注意力 kernel，在 tile 粒度组合两种低比特计算并以 Triton 融合实现新一代 GPU 推理。
abstract.en: DMA is a mixed-precision attention kernel for low-bit MXFP formats, combining two low-bit computation modes at tile granularity in a fused Triton implementation for new GPUs.

problem.zh: 注意力的二次计算和高精度内存带宽使推理昂贵，但统一低精度容易损害生成质量，也难充分利用新硬件的 microscaling 单元。
problem.en: Quadratic attention and high-precision bandwidth make inference expensive, yet uniform low precision can hurt generation quality and underuse new microscaling hardware.

approach.zh: 内核按对角 tile 划分注意力，为不同区域选择两类低比特精度，并融合数据转换、矩阵计算和归约以减少中间访存。
approach.en: The kernel tiles attention diagonally, assigns two low-bit precisions to different regions, and fuses conversion, matrix computation, and reduction to minimize intermediate memory traffic.

system_design.zh: Triton kernel 读取 MXFP 表示，在 tile 调度器控制下执行混合精度矩阵运算，片上完成缩放与归并后直接写回注意力输出。
system_design.en: A Triton kernel reads MXFP representations, executes mixed-precision matrix operations under a tile scheduler, and performs scaling and reduction on chip before writing attention output.

key_results.zh: B200 实验中，融合 DMA kernel 在生成质量近乎不变的前提下显著加速注意力计算。
key_results.en: On B200 evaluations, the fused DMA kernel materially accelerates attention while keeping generation quality nearly unchanged.

limitations.zh: 实现依赖支持 MXFP 的新硬件且只在有限 GPU 上验证；低比特误差对更长上下文、不同模型和训练场景的影响尚不明确。
limitations.en: The implementation depends on new MXFP-capable hardware and is validated on limited GPUs; low-bit error over longer contexts, other models, or training remains unclear.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件与基线均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未给出可安全转录的结果数字，表格明细与部署配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, and baselines come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; the abstract provides no result number safe to transcribe, and table details plus deployment configuration still require full-text audit.
